text: The Endangered Species Reserve Fund (ESRF) supports conservation and education projects to benefit endangered species in Canada and around the world. The 2019 Endangered Species Reserve Fund Budget is attached for approval.
The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Approved ESRF Projects E1 to E5 and, 6 to 22 with net expenditures of $81,525 for funding from the Endangered Species Reserve Fund.
